title: Dinkum: room-code co-op is playable on OpenPak
body: Dinkum now plays online on OpenPak. A host on an emulator and a real Switch have joined each other's towns by room code, in both directions. Friend-list search and invites are still being built, so for now you join a friend by sharing a room code. Dinkum is a cozy survival life sim from No More Robots, and online play is being checked further as the rest of the friend features land.
